entries.name: color
entries.prompt: Create one monochrome toolbar icon for the color blend mode in a desktop graphics editor. Subject: three overlapping paint drops. Pure white solid glyph on genuinely transparent background. Bold simple geometric silhouette, consistent rounded stroke weight, legible at 18 pixels, no lettering, no gradients, no shadows, no border, no decorative background. Center glyph in square canvas, occupy 75 percent of canvas, generous transparent margin. Output a single icon only.
